title: Financial ratios and business diagnosis
author: financial diagnosis specialist

scope.outcome: Interpret ratios in context and explain accounting comparability limitations.
scope.teach_back: Answered explanation of growth/profit/cash/funding, policy-induced return trend and documentary evidence.
scope.retention: Answered additional15 credit sales collected within the period, including tax, income, CFO, cash, equity, ROIC and revised average-equity ROE.
scope.case: Original Aster two360-day-period business in kCU, three balanced balance sheets, two complete income and cash-flow statements, matched-average returns and all-cash-excluded IC.
scope.comparison: Full50/20-versus30/40 book-depreciation bridge with unchanged tax deductions, DTA recognition/reversal, both cash statements identical, reversed ROE/ROIC trends and identical terminal statements.

reasoning_checks: Every ratio declares stock/flow timing, common entity/currency, capital ownership and numerator/denominator interpretation. Average versus ending/beginning balances, seasonality, acquisition timing and simple annualization boundaries are taught before exercises.

Aster sales and goods purchases are entirely credit; separate depreciation never enters inventory COGS. All three balance sheets close, PPE/debt/equity roll, direct and indirect CFO agree, and purchases are not counted twice as cash.

Current/quick/cash resources and interest-bearing debt/total-liability measures are distinct. Financing obligations, netting convention, EBITDA limitations and dated cash funding are explained without universal normative ratios or covenant claims.

Payable days use purchases while inventory days use COGS and receivable days use credit sales. Underlying physical, collection and contract mechanisms remain hypotheses; aggregates are not invoice-specific durations.

Three-factor and five-factor DuPont are explicitly derived by cancellation with matching averages and domains. Equity multiplier is not one plus interest-bearing debt/equity. Leverage spread derivation is separately limited to fixed beginning capital, no operating liabilities/cash/tax and no feedback.

ROIC matches hypothetical after-tax operating earnings with explicit operating capital. DTA/DTL treatment, all-cash exclusion and financing-side equality are reconciled, without treating NOPAT as cash or asserting every firm can use a nominal tax benefit.

Alternative depreciation is a controlled measurement comparison, not a claim that either pattern is freely permissible. Both numerator and intermediate capital change; deferred tax restores identical cash and terminal balances. DTA recoverability is explicitly supplied rather than proved by calculation.

Peer selection precedes ranking and addresses operating activity, geography, asset age, period, acquisition and consolidation differences. Median versus aggregated denominator-weighted ratios are distinguished. Adjusted peer return uses supplied continuing-operation capital.

Zero sales/interest/PBT and negative or tiny equity/capital are explained rather than assigned fabricated normal ratios. Signed negative-coverage numerators are distinguished from nonpositive denominators; unsupported tax-loss rules are outside the transaction lab.

All eight complete prompt/solution pairs and both teaching answers manually matched for inputs, requested outputs, units, domains and interpretation. Independent exact calculations support but do not replace the prose review.

limitations: Synthetic conditional business model; invoice quality, tax recoverability, asset consumption, peer suitability and feasible operating changes need independent evidence.
Endpoint averages proxy intra-year exposure; no transaction-weighted path supplied. All-cash exclusion is a declared ROIC convention, not proof that operations need zero cash.
Narrow two-period lab requires nonnegative book/tax profit and supported deferred tax; no general tax-loss, multirate, consolidation, lease or acquisition engine.
No guarantee of error-free work, professional certification, a real investment result or institutional acceptance.
No browser/mobile/print visual QA; coordinator integrates structural build and prerequisite-ordered acceptance.
